title: The Voynich Manuscript
dek: A 15th-century codex in an unknown script with botanical illustrations of no known plants, held at Yale and unread despite a century of professional and amateur attempts.
full_text:
Folio 1r, opening lines, in the Extensible Voynich Alphabet — the
transliteration scheme researchers use to quote a text nobody can read.
The glyphs are transcribed; the words are not translated, because no
translation has ever been demonstrated.

fachys ykal ar ataiin shol shory cth res y kor sholdy
sory ckhar or y kair chtaiin shar are cthar cthar dan
syaiir sheky or ykaiin shod cthoary cthes daraiin sa
ooiin oteey oteos roloty cthar daiin okaiin or okan
dair y chear cthaiin cphar cfhaiin
